title: Mark Zuckerberg: Meta's Open AI Models and New Coding Agent
description: Recent reports highlight Mark Zuckerberg's stance on AI rivals and Meta's new developments in coding agents, according to major news outlets.

sections.heading: Criticism of Closed AI Models
paragraphs: According to the Financial Times, Mark Zuckerberg has attacked 'closed' AI rivals. This criticism comes as Meta returns to open models.

sections.heading: New AI Coding Agent
paragraphs: CNBC reports that Meta has debuted its first AI coding agent. The release is positioned as a move to take on Anthropic and OpenAI.

sections.heading: Big Tech and AI Performance
paragraphs: According to Digital Today, Big Tech is stepping up its push into coding AI. The report notes that this involves arming with China AI performance.
